name: inspira-ripple-button
description: A button that creates expanding circular ripples from the click point on top of the button, using clientX/clientY and animating opacity and scale.
use_when: You want material-design-style ripple feedback on click.
avoid_when: On touch devices where ripple position may be inaccurate; also CPU-heavy with many ripples.
a11y: Standard button semantics. Ripples are visual feedback. No aria attributes for ripple state.
